title: Content Writer
description:
Job Description

Aatmia Digital Marketing & Security Pvt Ltd is looking for a creative and enthusiastic Content Writer who can develop engaging content for multiple client brands across different industries. The candidate should have strong writing skills, creative thinking, and an understanding of social media trends, storytelling, and SEO content creation.

The role involves writing social media captions, developing creative concepts, scripting Instagram Reels and promotional videos, and creating SEO-friendly website content and blogs whenever required.

Freshers with excellent writing skills and a passion for content creation are welcome to apply.

Roles and Responsibilities

* Create engaging and creative content for social media platforms, including Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube.
* Write compelling scripts for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, promotional videos, advertisements, and brand campaigns.
* Develop creative hooks, storytelling concepts, and call-to-actions to improve audience engagement.
* Prepare social media captions, post descriptions, campaign content, and brand communication.
* Research trending topics, audience interests, competitor content, and industry developments.
* Create monthly social media content calendars for multiple clients across different industries.
* Write SEO-friendly website content, landing pages, blogs, articles, and service descriptions whenever required.
* Conduct keyword research and incorporate relevant keywords naturally into website content.
* Optimize content for readability, search intent, and search engine visibility.
* Understand brand guidelines, target audiences, and marketing objectives before developing content.
* Coordinate with graphic designers, video editors, social media executives, and SEO teams to execute content plans.
* Assist during video shoots with script preparation, dialogue suggestions, and content execution.
* Proofread and edit content to ensure accuracy, grammar, consistency, and quality.
* Stay updated with social media trends, content formats, SEO practices, and AI-driven search developments.

Required Skills

* Excellent written communication and creative writing skills.
* Strong storytelling and script-writing abilities.
* Good understanding of social media platforms and current content trends.
* Ability to write engaging hooks and scripts that capture attention in the first few seconds.
* Basic knowledge of SEO content writing, keyword placement, headings, and search intent.
* Ability to adapt writing styles for different brands, industries, and target audiences.
* Good research skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple content assignments and meet deadlines.
* Familiarity with AI writing tools and the ability to use them responsibly while maintaining originality.
* Basic understanding of digital marketing and content marketing.

Preferred Qualifications

* Any degree or diploma in English, Journalism, Mass Communication, Marketing, or a related field.
* Freshers with strong writing samples and creative ideas are encouraged to apply.
* Experience in social media content writing, script writing, blogging, or SEO writing is an added advantage.
* Knowledge of Tamil and English writing is preferred.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work with multiple brands and industries.
* Exposure to social media campaigns, video production, and digital marketing projects.
* Opportunities to develop creative writing and content strategy skills.
* A collaborative environment with designers, video editors, SEO specialists, and digital marketers.
* Career growth opportunities in content marketing and digital strategy.

Work Schedule

Full-Time | Day Shift | Work from Office

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Leave encashment

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Perungudi, Chennai, Tamil Nadu: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)

Application Question(s):

* What are your current salary & expected salary?
* Do you have experience writing SEO-friendly blogs or website content?
* Have you written scripts for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, or promotional videos?

Experience:

* Content creation: 1 year (Preferred)

**Why choose AstraZeneca India?**
---------------------------------

Help push the boundaries of science to deliver life-changing medicines to patients. After 45 years in India, we’re continuing to secure a future where everyone can access affordable, sustainable, innovative healthcare.

The part you play in our business will be challenging, yet rewarding, requiring you to use your resilient, collaborative and diplomatic skillsets to make connections. The majority of your work will be field based, and will require you to be highly-organised, planning your monthly schedule, attending meetings and calls, as well as writing up reports.

**Who do we look for?**
-----------------------

Calling all tech innovators, ownership takers, challenge seekers and proactive collaborators. At AstraZeneca, breakthroughs born in the lab become transformative medicine for the world's most complex diseases. We empower people like you to push the boundaries of science, challenge convention, and unleash your entrepreneurial spirit. You'll embrace differences and take bold actions to drive the change needed to meet global healthcare and sustainability challenges.

Here, diverse minds and bold disruptors can meaningfully impact the future of healthcare using cutting-edge technology. Whether you join us in Bengaluru or Chennai, you can make a tangible impact within a global biopharmaceutical company that invests in your future. Join a talented global team that's powering AstraZeneca to better serve patients every day.

**Success Profile**
-------------------

Ready to make an impact in your career? If you're passionate, growth-orientated and a true team player, we'll help you succeed. Here are some of the skills and capabilities we look for.

### **Tech innovators**

Make a greater impact through our digitally enabled enterprise. Use your skills in data and technology to transform and optimise our operations, helping us deliver meaningful work that changes lives.

### **Ownership takers**

If you're a self-aware self-starter who craves autonomy, AstraZeneca provides the perfect environment to take ownership and grow. Here, you'll feel empowered to lead and reach excellence at every level — with unrivalled support when you need it.

### **Challenge seekers**

Adapting and advancing our progress means constantly challenging the status quo. In this dynamic environment where everything we do has urgency and focus, you'll have the ability to show up, speak up and confidently take smart risks.

### **Proactive collaborators**

Your unique perspectives make our ambitions and capabilities possible. Our culture of sharing ideas, learning and improving together helps us consistently set the bar higher. As a proactive collaborator, you'll seek out ways to bring people together to achieve their best.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**Job ID** R-262726 **Date posted** 10/26/2026

**Job Title: Associate Director II, CReW**

**Global Career Level: E3**

**Role Type: Individual Contributor**

**Work Location: Embassy Manyata Business Park**

**About AstraZeneca**

AstraZeneca is a global, science-led, patient-focused biopharmaceutical company that focuses on the discovery, development, and commercialization of prescription medicines targeting some of the planet’s most serious diseases. But we’re more than one of the world’s leading pharmaceutical companies. At AstraZeneca, we 're dedicated to being a Great Place to Work.

**About the role**

**Introduction to role:**

The role holders provide strategic leadership and communications expertise to clinical drug programs. They author clinical-regulatory documents and provide critical review to achieve high-quality standards. They represent the skill on drug and non-drug projects.

The Clinical Regulatory Writing team provides expert communications leadership to drug projects and authors strategically important clinical-regulatory documents that are label focused and align with project strategies, regulatory requirements, and communications best-practices. We support the Company’s core therapeutic areas in all phases of clinical development. Our vision is to be an industry leading organization driving critical communication excellence to achieve successful submissions and approvals.

**Accountabilities:**

Portfolio Leadership: Independently manage clinical regulatory writing across a complex portfolio, prioritizing impact and ensuring delivery to time and quality.

Authoritative Document Ownership: Serve as lead author for the most complex clinical-regulatory documents in a program, meeting all technical, regulatory, and quality standards while applying best practice and continuous improvement.

Submission Communications Strategy: When acting as submission lead, drive the clinical Submission Communication Strategy (cSCS), aligning cross-functional teams around clear positions and messages that anticipate regulator needs.

Strategic Communications Partnership: As part of clinical delivery and submission teams, provide strategic communications leadership, set communication standards, and champion quality, efficiency, and consistency across programs.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with clinical, biostatistics, regulatory, safety, and operations teams to interpret complex data and craft concise, accurate messages that answer customer and regulator questions.

Vendor and Team Leadership: Lead internal and external authoring teams, including vendor medical writers, to scale delivery while upholding scientific integrity and message discipline.

Program-Level Influence: Operate proactively at the program level, shaping clinical narratives across studies and indications and ensuring coherence from protocol to label.

Talent Development: Support the development of Clinical Regulatory Writing Managers, sharing frameworks, feedback, and coaching to set the standard across the skill.

Operational Excellence: Drive continuous improvement in our authoring model, tools, and ways of working, representing the writing skill in drug and non-drug projects for broader organizational benefit.

**Essential Skills/Experience:**

* Life Sciences degree in an appropriate subject area.
* Minimum 10+ years of significant medical writing experience in the pharmaceutical industry or CRO.
* Ability to advise and lead communication projects.
* Understand drug development and communication process from development, launch through life cycle management.
* In depth knowledge of the technical and regulatory requirements related to the role.

**Desirable Skills/Experience:**

* Advanced degree in a scientific field (Ph.D.).

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility.

Join us in our unique and ambitious world.

**Why AstraZeneca:**

At AstraZeneca's Biopharmaceuticals R&D, we are part of the solution, turning our drug development strategies into reality. We work at all stages of development to translate our life-changing science into medicines to get the best results for AstraZeneca, patients in need and healthcare professionals. We are a diverse and open-minded team harnessing our different skills and experiences. Our differences enable us to explore new ideas and ways of doing things. It keeps us on our toes and excited for what's next.

**Where Can I Find Out More?**

Our Social Media, Follow AstraZeneca on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/1603/

**Call to Action:**

Step into the role that turns evidence into approvals—shape the submissions that change labels and lives, and lead the next chapter of clinical communication excellence!
